intent: Clarify receipt delivery rule: do not send emails for every receipt; post receipts in thread and commit to GitHub/Pen by default.

contact_correction.rule: Do not use the 4pm.net.au address. Use troy@tech4humanity.com.au only when the user explicitly asks for email delivery or the workflow specifically requires email.

default_delivery: post receipt details back in the chat thread
commit receipt or handoff payload to GitHub/Pen
email_allowed_when: the workflow is specifically an email/reporting workflow
a critical escalation policy explicitly requires email
receipt_delivery_policy.thread_close_rule: Once the GitHub/Pen receipt is posted back in the thread, the chat thread may close as HANDOFF_COMPLETE unless the user explicitly requested runtime closure in-thread.
